title: Wijken en Buurten 2025 (Neighborhoods and Districts with Demographics)
description:
The definitive Dutch demographic geodataset. Published annually by CBS (Statistics Netherlands), this dataset provides demographic, socioeconomic, and geographic statistics at three nested administrative levels: buurten (14,823 neighborhoods), wijken (3,423 districts), and gemeenten (424 municipalities). Contains ~42 columns covering population, age distribution, household composition, marital status, migration background, urbanity, and land/water area. Statistics reflect the situation as of 1 January 2025. All three layers share the same column schema and form a strict spatial hierarchy: each buurt belongs to exactly one wijk, each wijk to one gemeente. The sentinel value -99997 means data is not available or privacy-suppressed.

🤖 AI/Agent users: See llms.txt for field descriptions, query examples, and usage tips.

table:columns.name: buurtcode
table:columns.description: CBS area code with prefix BU (buurt), WK (wijk), or GM (gemeente) followed by digits. Encodes the hierarchical relationship: BU00140000 -> WK001400 -> GM0014.

table:columns.name: buurtnaam
table:columns.description: Human-readable name of the area (buurtnaam / wijknaam / gemeentenaam depending on layer).

table:columns.name: wijkcode
table:columns.description: Parent district code (WK + 6 digits). Present on buurten layer only.

table:columns.name: gemeentecode
table:columns.description: Municipality code (GM + 4 digits). Present on buurten and wijken layers.

table:columns.name: gemeentenaam
table:columns.description: Municipality name. Present on buurten and wijken layers.

table:columns.name: indelingswijziging_wijken_en_buurten
table:columns.description: Boundary change flag: 1 = boundaries changed vs previous year, 0 = unchanged.

table:columns.name: water
table:columns.description: Water area indicator: JA = water body, NEE = land area. Water areas have suppressed demographics.

table:columns.name: meest_voorkomende_postcode
table:columns.description: Most common 4-digit postal code (PC4) in this area.

table:columns.name: dekkingspercentage
table:columns.description: Percentage of addresses covered by the most common postal code.

table:columns.name: omgevingsadressendichtheid
table:columns.description: Average number of addresses within 1 km radius of each address. Measure of local urbanization.

table:columns.name: stedelijkheid_adressen_per_km2
table:columns.description: CBS urbanity class (1-5): 1=very highly urban (>=2500 addr/km2), 5=rural (<500 addr/km2).

table:columns.name: bevolkingsdichtheid_inwoners_per_km2
table:columns.description: Population density: residents per km2 of land area.

table:columns.name: aantal_inwoners
table:columns.description: Total population (number of residents).

table:columns.name: mannen
table:columns.description: Number of male residents.

table:columns.name: vrouwen
table:columns.description: Number of female residents.

table:columns.name: percentage_personen_0_tot_15_jaar
table:columns.description: Percentage of population aged 0-14 (children).

table:columns.name: percentage_personen_15_tot_25_jaar
table:columns.description: Percentage of population aged 15-24 (young adults).

table:columns.name: percentage_personen_25_tot_45_jaar
table:columns.description: Percentage of population aged 25-44 (young working age).

table:columns.name: percentage_personen_45_tot_65_jaar
table:columns.description: Percentage of population aged 45-64 (older working age).

table:columns.name: percentage_personen_65_jaar_en_ouder
table:columns.description: Percentage of population aged 65+ (elderly/retired).

table:columns.name: percentage_ongehuwd
table:columns.description: Percentage never married.

table:columns.name: percentage_gehuwd
table:columns.description: Percentage currently married (incl. registered partnerships).

table:columns.name: percentage_gescheid
table:columns.description: Percentage divorced.

table:columns.name: percentage_verweduwd
table:columns.description: Percentage widowed.

table:columns.name: aantal_huishoudens
table:columns.description: Total number of private households.

table:columns.name: percentage_eenpersoonshuishoudens
table:columns.description: Percentage of single-person households.

table:columns.name: percentage_huishoudens_zonder_kinderen
table:columns.description: Percentage of multi-person households without children.

table:columns.name: percentage_huishoudens_met_kinderen
table:columns.description: Percentage of households with children.

table:columns.name: gemiddelde_huishoudsgrootte
table:columns.description: Average household size (persons per household).

table:columns.name: percentage_met_herkomstland_nederland
table:columns.description: Percentage with Dutch migration background (both parents born in NL).

table:columns.name: percentage_met_herkomstland_uit_europa_excl_nl
table:columns.description: Percentage with European migration background (excl. Netherlands).

table:columns.name: percentage_met_herkomstland_buiten_europa
table:columns.description: Percentage with non-European migration background.

table:columns.name: percentage_geb_in_nl_met_herkomstland_nederland
table:columns.description: Percentage born in NL with Dutch background (native Dutch).

table:columns.name: perc_geb_in_nl_met_herkomstland_in_europa_ex_nl
table:columns.description: Percentage born in NL with European background (2nd generation European).

table:columns.name: perc_geb_in_nl_met_herkomstland_buiten_europa
table:columns.description: Percentage born in NL with non-European background (2nd generation non-European).

table:columns.name: perc_geb_buiten_nl_met_herkomstlnd_in_europa_ex_nl
table:columns.description: Percentage born abroad with European background (1st generation European immigrant).

table:columns.name: perc_geb_buiten_nl_met_herkomstlnd_buiten_europa
table:columns.description: Percentage born abroad with non-European background (1st generation non-European immigrant).

table:columns.name: oppervlakte_totaal_in_ha
table:columns.description: Total area in hectares (land + water).

table:columns.name: oppervlakte_land_in_ha
table:columns.description: Land area in hectares.

table:columns.name: oppervlakte_water_in_ha
table:columns.description: Water area in hectares.

table:columns.name: jrstatcode
table:columns.description: Composite key: year + area code, e.g. '2025BU00140000'. Unique across multi-year datasets.

table:columns.name: jaar
table:columns.description: Reference year (2025 for all records in this edition).

table:columns.name: geometry
table:columns.description: Area boundary polygon in EPSG:28992 (Amersfoort / RD New), WKB encoded.
